verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit publishes an OpenAPI spec on its own docs site (the probe found docs.coderabbit.ai/openapi.json returning HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key), which is a first-party API reference artifact. Nothing in the evidence shows that this spec is rendered as an interactive explorer or that it includes runnable examples. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API reference UI, runnable or try-it examples, documented API endpoint pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.coderabbit.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
